claims.text: An ab initio-trained machine-learning potential can improve determination of the solid-to-fluid transition temperature in a multicomponent high-entropy material.
An ab initio-trained machine-learning potential can improve determination of fusion enthalpy.
An ab initio-trained machine-learning potential can improve determination of fusion entropy.
An ab initio-trained machine-learning potential can improve determination of the volume change at the transition.
An ab initio-trained machine-learning potential can improve determination of dense-fluid heat capacity.
The machine-learning potential can accurately capture the complex interactions in the multicomponent system.
Capturing the multicomponent interactions with the machine-learning potential enables efficient thermodynamic-property calculations.
Capturing the multicomponent interactions with the machine-learning potential enables accurate thermodynamic-property calculations.
The machine-learning-potential approach will be more efficient than ab initio molecular dynamics.
The machine-learning-potential approach will be more accurate than classical molecular dynamics.
The proposed approach is applicable to multicomponent high-entropy materials at high temperatures.
Transferability of the potential across temperatures and compositions is uncertain.
Overfitting or underfitting could limit the potential's accuracy.
